verdict.rationale: Polar is a payments and billing Merchant of Record platform, not an AI agent or host that calls tools, so consuming external MCP servers is outside its product role. The evidence documents only Polar's own MCP server, which external agents such as Cursor and Claude connect to. That is the server role and does not show Polar acting as an MCP client, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
